declarations.description:
A data grid: a scrolling, virtualized table built from a `rows` array (or an async `dataSource`) and a set of
`c2-table-column` definitions given as light-DOM children. Sorting, row selection, column pinning, column resizing
and keyboard navigation are built in; every cell can be rendered by a function, so a cell body can be any markup —
including other c2 components.

Rows and columns are readable from markup as JSON attributes as well as from script as properties, so a table can be
authored without a build step:

```html
<c2-table row-key="id" selection="multiple" checkbox-selection sortable stripe style="height: 320px">
  <c2-table-column field="name" header="Name" width="2fr" pinned="start"></c2-table-column>
  <c2-table-column field="score" header="Score" width="120px" align="end" format="number"></c2-table-column>
</c2-table>
```

**Layout.** The table is one CSS grid: the header row and every body row are grid items using `grid-template-columns:
subgrid`, so columns stay aligned without any scroll syncing, and pinned columns are `position: sticky` cells rather
than separate containers. Give the host a height (or `--c2-table--max-height`) — the body scrolls inside it.

**Virtualization** windows the rows to the visible range plus an overscan margin. It needs a uniform row height, which
it measures from the first rendered row, so theme the height with `--c2-table__row--height` (`row-height` is only the
estimate used for the first paint). It turns on automatically past `virtual-threshold` rows; `virtual="always"` and
`virtual="never"` force it.

members.name: rows
members.description: The rows to display. An array in the property, JSON in the attribute.

members.name: columns
members.description: Column definitions, as an alternative to `c2-table-column` children. Children win when both are present.

members.name: rowKey
members.description: Field used as the identity of a row, for selection and DOM reuse. Falls back to the row index.

members.name: selection
members.description: `single` selects one row at a time, `multiple` supports ⌘/ctrl-click and shift-click ranges.

members.name: checkboxSelection
members.description: Adds a leading checkbox column, pinned to the start.

members.name: value
members.description: Keys of the selected rows: an array in the property, `;`-separated in the attribute.

members.name: sortModel
members.description: The sort, in priority order: `SortModel[]` in the property, `field:asc;other:desc` in the `sort` attribute.

members.name: multiSort
members.description: Lets shift-click add a column to the sort instead of replacing it.

members.name: sortable
members.description: Makes every column sortable; a column's own `sortable` still wins.

members.name: resizable
members.description: Makes every column resizable; a column's own `resizable` still wins.

members.name: stripe
members.description: Tints odd rows with `--c2-table__row__odd--background`.

members.name: virtual
members.description: `auto` virtualizes past `virtual-threshold` rows; `always` and `never` force it.

members.name: rowHeight
members.description: Row height in pixels used before the first row has been measured.

members.name: overscan
members.description: Rows rendered above and below the viewport while virtualizing.

members.name: virtualThreshold
members.description: Row count past which `virtual="auto"` starts windowing.

members.name: dataSource
members.description: Lazy row source used instead of `rows`; the table requests one block at a time as rows scroll into view.

members.name: blockSize
members.description: Number of rows the table asks a `dataSource` for at a time.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows the loading state; implied while a `dataSource` resolves its first block.

members.name: error
members.description: Shows the error state with this message.

members.name: emptyMessage
members.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

members.name: #virtualizer
members.default: new VirtualScrollController(this, { scrollElement: () => this.viewport, itemCount: () => this.rowCount, itemHeight: () => this.#rowHeightPx, overscan: () => this.overscan, enabled: () => this.isVirtualized, })

members.name: rowCount
members.description: Number of rows the table knows about: `rows.length`, or the `dataSource` total.

members.name: isVirtualized
members.description: Whether the rows are currently windowed.

members.name: resolvedColumns
members.description: The resolved, ordered, visible columns — children first, then the `columns` property, then one per key of the first row.

members.name: getSelectedRows
members.description: The rows currently selected. Only the loaded ones when a `dataSource` is used.

members.name: selectAll
members.description: Selects every loaded row. No-op unless `selection="multiple"`.

members.name: clearSelection
members.description: Clears the selection.

members.name: scrollToIndex
members.description: Scrolls the row at `index` into view.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Drops the `dataSource` cache and reloads the visible rows.

members.name: #handleColumnChange
members.description: A column definition changed one of its own properties: re-read them all, keeping the event inside the table.

members.name: #syncFocusToWindow
members.description: Keeps the roving tabindex on a rendered cell: follows the window when focused, falls back to the header otherwise.

events.name: sort-change
events.description: Fired after the user clicks a sortable header. `detail.sort` is the new sort model, in priority order.

events.name: row-click
events.description: Fired when a row is clicked, before the selection is applied.

events.name: cell-click
events.description: Fired when a cell is clicked; adds `detail.column` and `detail.value`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the array of selected row keys, `detail.rows` the matching rows.

events.name: column-resize
events.description: Fired when the user releases a column's resize handle.

declarations.name: COLUMN_CHANGE_EVENT
declarations.description: Fired at the parent table whenever a column definition changes.

One column of a `c2-table`, declared as a light-DOM child. The element renders nothing: it is a definition the
table reads, the same way `c2-select` reads its `c2-list-item` children. Everything it exposes as an attribute can
also be set as a property, and the function-valued properties (`renderCell`, `renderHeader`, `comparator`) are
property-only.

```html
<c2-table rows='[{ "name": "Ada", "score": 12 }]'>
  <c2-table-column field="name" header="Name" width="2fr" sortable pinned="start"></c2-table-column>
  <c2-table-column field="score" header="Score" width="120px" align="end" format="number" sortable></c2-table-column>
</c2-table>
```
declarations.name: TableColumn

members.name: field
members.description: Key of the value in the row object; may be a dotted path such as `user.name`.

members.name: header
members.description: Header label. Falls back to the field name.

members.name: width
members.description: Grid track for the column: `1fr`, `160px`, `minmax(120px, 1fr)`…

members.name: minWidth
members.description: Lower bound in pixels while the column is resized.

members.name: align
members.description: Horizontal alignment of the header and the cells.

members.name: sortable
members.description: Lets the user sort by this column.

members.name: resizable
members.description: Lets the user drag the column's trailing edge. Defaults to the table's `resizable`.

members.name: pinned
members.description: Freezes the column against the leading or trailing edge while scrolling horizontally.

members.name: hidden
members.description: Leaves the column out of the table without removing the definition.

members.name: format
members.description: Built-in `Intl` formatting applied when no `renderCell` is set.

members.name: formatOptions
members.description: Options handed to the `Intl` formatter of `format`, as JSON in the attribute.

members.name: currency
members.description: Currency code used by `format="currency"`.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale used by `format`. Defaults to the browser locale.

members.name: cellClass
members.description: Class set on every cell of this column, so light-DOM CSS can target it through `::part(cell)`.

members.name: renderCell
members.description: Renders the cell body. Property only.

members.name: renderHeader
members.description: Renders the header body. Property only.

members.name: comparator
members.description: Client-side sort comparator for this column's values. Property only.
